scope: Read-only review of 32 recording/comping requirements, all 78 case definitions, both canonical pages, all four retained official HTML chapters, packet source inventory and manifest; no handoff release review

findings.problem: The D12 clause generalizes recording of scene tempo/meter changes beyond the condition retained in its cited source. Captured R7 section 7.5 limits these changes to tempo/time-signature values included in names of launched scenes. The requirement currently omits the scene-name condition. It also has no explicit documentary case for scene tempo/meter changes.

evidence.qualifier: if they are included in the names of launched scenes

findings.requested_change: Narrow the D12 statement to the retained launched-scene-name condition, or cite retained evidence for a broader field-based scene recording contract. Keep unestablished broader behavior U. Add or explicitly defer a documentary scene-tempo/meter scenario; do not import an exact-build assumption.

findings.problem: Session override and Back to Arrangement clauses and RC-074 duplicate Arrangement REQ-020/021 and AR-044 to AR-046. Both new drafts currently claim ownership of the same observable transition.
findings.requested_change: During parent integration choose Arrangement as the canonical playback-override contract and link the recording-specific dependency, or explicitly assign another single owner. Keep Session recording output in this recording draft.

findings.problem: File Type/Bit Depth selection is a D12 clause, but RC-058 to RC-060 cover channel count and destinations only. The count of 78 scenarios should not be read as clause-complete acceptance coverage. Similar finite omissions exist for main/take selection defaults and some metronome controls.
findings.requested_change: Retain partial-coverage wording. If this clause is selected for a future handoff, add a finite format/bit-depth scenario or label that subclause excluded from the release.

checks.manual_support: All requirement/case documentary source sections inspected; REQ-031 qualifier finding above. Captured manual version 12 has exact patch U throughout. No source-name to runtime transition leap found.
checks.storage_vs_runtime_boundary: pass: stored metadata is not promoted to loader/save/allocation/identity proof
checks.lifecycle_boundary: pass: finite documented undo clauses distinguished; save/redo/cancel/failure/teardown/malformed/timing unknowns retained
checks.scenario_vs_fixture_boundary: pass: scenarios explicitly unexecuted, no generated/retained application fixtures claimed

integration_note: All 74 application cases remain ungraded for 12.4.3; source integrity and D12 documentary support are not exact-build behavior or complete feature coverage.
